outcome: Mean daily energy and protein intakes
cohort: The study included 139 preterm infants born before 32 weeks of gestation or with birth weights under 1250 g, divided into a PRE group (individualized PN) and a POST group (standardized PN protocol).
finding: Implementation of a standardized parenteral nutrition protocol improved early nutritional intake, led to better weight and weight velocity by day 28, and reduced the incidence of bacterial sepsis in premature infants.
followup_time: 28 days for growth outcomes, and up to >90 days for hospitalization duration
